profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I'm a Senior Software Engineer with over 10 years of experience, specializing in fullstack JavaScript development. I’m passionate about solving complex technical challenges and staying at the forefront of new technologies. With a versatile skill set, I’ve delivered solutions for private companies, government projects, NGOs, and freelance clients. My expertise spans Node.js, TypeScript, React, SQL, Dynamo, Redis, Queues, Distributed Systems, with a strong focus on building scalable, robust systems.

Always open to new challenges and opportunities. Willing to relocate.
